targetGeometryEvidence: No-cookie category-filtered target bbox returned two land-plot MultiPolygons, PROPCODE 1-01-02-0011-0889 and 1-01-02-0011-0890; the selected center is inside 0890. A 3x3 adjacent bounded sample returned 111 unique land plots. coverageAssessment.claimedScope: National public cadastre map; exact city coverage not documented in inspected metadata.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No-cookie 0.0002-degree center query plus 3x3 adjacent 0.0025-degree neighborhood; 111 unique land polygons across nine cells; each cell’s bounded paging reached an empty terminal page. This is local sampling, not citywide extent or completeness.
coverageAssessment.paginationCheck: Nine cells: 55 HTTP 200 requests total, each capped at three; all terminal pages empty. A separate anonymous ascending PROPCODE sort check returned repeatable page 0, an ordered short page at offset 24, and empty at 26 for the center cell.

blocker: Public center sample is verified, but neighborhood quality needs production QA: 3 of 111 features are invalid and 12 pairs have positive-area intersections. PROPCODE permanence/global uniqueness and full-city coverage are undocumented.
remainingUncertainty: Whether overlaps are legitimate lineage/topology or source defects; how to repair/omit invalid shapes; whether PROPCODE is permanently unique; exact citywide extent; and completeness beyond bounded local query cells.
nextStep: Use a source-specific bounded WFS adapter only after geospatial QA defines handling for invalid geometries and positive-area overlaps; retain PROPCODE as the public code with permanence semantics explicitly unverified.
verifiedSampleBasis: The public source returned 111 unique category-filtered land-plot polygons with PROPCODE across nine bounded cells; sample verification is complete. Runtime geometry remains held because 3/111 geometries are invalid and 12 feature pairs have positive-area intersections. This is not citywide coverage.
runtimeGeometryHold: Do not wire to runtime until handling for invalid geometries and overlapping pairs is resolved; prototype adapter remains unwired.
